image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a silver alloy car wheel mounted on a vehicle. The wheel features a five-spoke design with a polished metallic finish. A black rubber tire surrounds the rim, showing visible tread patterns and sidewall details. The central hub contains five lug nuts arranged in a pentagonal pattern around a center cap. The background includes a portion of the car's body panel (silver/grey) and a textured paved ground surface.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of wheel (alloy vs steel) and verify class alignment with high confidence.
To verify the contact shadow between the tire and the pavement, ensuring the wheel is grounded and not floating.
To check for any melting or fusion artifacts at the complex boundaries of the spoke gaps and the tire sidewall.

Contact patch between tire and ground
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflection consistency on the curved surfaces of the alloy spokes. AI often distorts reflections on complex curved metal. Also, verify that the lug nuts are identical in shape and orientation relative to the hub center.
